name: mastodon
description: Mastodon MCP server for Claude Code and AI agents. 76 tools for posting, editing, threads, timelines, search, lists, notifications and following, across any instance.
long_description:
Connects Claude to Mastodon, on any instance.

Mastodon is federated, so an account is a token plus the instance that issued it. Paste your instance URL and an access token from that instance's Settings -> Development, and this connects. There is no central developer portal to visit.

Writes are on. Anything public or irreversible - posting, editing, deleting, boosting, following, blocking - refuses to run until it is confirmed, and Read only hides every one of them.

instance_url.title: Your instance
instance_url.description: The server your account lives on, for example https://mastodon.social. A token is only valid on the instance that issued it.

access_token.title: Access token
access_token.description: From that instance's Settings -> Development -> New application. Give it the read and write scopes, then copy "Your access token".

read_only.title: Read only
read_only.description: Hide every tool that can post, edit, delete, boost, follow or block.
